description: This source file defines an internal struct named PaddedLong, which is used to implement a padded long value to prevent false sharing by aligning the Value field with cache line boundaries. It includes methods for volatile reading and compare-and-swap operations, leveraging low-level memory operations for thread safety and performance optimization.

classes.name: PaddedLong
classes.description: A thread-safe, CPU cache line-aligned wrapper around a long value with padding to avoid false sharing.

methods.name: VolatileRead
methods.description: Performs a volatile read of the Value field, preventing reordering of memory operations on systems that require it.

methods.name: CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Atomically compares the current Value with an expected value and, if they are equal, updates it to a new value.
